data.name: 3M 2097 P100 Particulate Filters
data.summary: Round P100 particulate filters with nuisance-level organic-vapor relief. They do not replace gas/vapor cartridges. The recorded five-pair Amazon.ca pack still needs quantity verification.
data.description: The 2097 is a particulate filter, not a chemical cartridge. 3M documents P100 filtration and limited organic-vapor odor relief below the applicable occupational exposure limit, whichever limit is lower. On an approved 6800 configuration, two matching filters are used at a time. The illustration shows ten filters, but it cannot establish the contents of Canadian ASIN B07FMJPFTY; the claimed five-pair pack remains unverified.

specs.label: Model / filter class
specs.value: 3M 2097; P100 particulate filter. Manufacturer designation, not authentication of the listed unit

specs.label: Protection scope
specs.value: P100 filtration of certain oil and non-oil particles, with nuisance-level organic-vapor relief only; not protection against hazardous gas/vapor concentrations.

specs.label: Compatible respirators
specs.value: 3M bayonet 6000-series full facepieces, including 6800 Medium, in configurations covered by the applicable instructions and approval label; mechanical fit alone does not establish hazard suitability

specs.label: Components in use
specs.value: Two matching filters or cartridges on the facepiece; replace as instructed. This is the assembly count, not a verified Amazon package quantity

specs.label: Service and replacement
specs.value: Inspect before use. Leave the contaminated area and replace damaged, soiled or difficult-to-breathe-through filters; follow all application-specific time limits and the package use-by date

specs.label: Air supply / exclusions
specs.value: Supplies no oxygen; not for oxygen-deficient, unknown or immediately dangerous to life or health (IDLH) atmospheres

pros: Compact round particulate-filter format for a correctly selected approved assembly.
Manufacturer installation and replacement instructions are available for the exact model family.
cons: Nuisance-level organic-vapor relief is not protection against hazardous gases or vapors. The 2097 does not replace a chemical cartridge selected for those hazards.
Requires a compatible facepiece, matching components, fit testing, training and a user seal check; a seal check does not replace a fit test.
The Canadian listing, genuine supply, package quantity, delivered lot and expiration remain unverified.
useCases: Compare particulate-filter options for an identified occupational aerosol hazard with a competent respiratory-protection professional.
Plan approved components, inspection, fit and replacement procedures before entering any assessed work area.

data.name: 3M 60921 Organic Vapor/P100 Cartridge Filters
data.summary: Combined organic-vapor cartridges and P100 filters for compatible 3M bayonet respirators. Select them for an identified hazard; they are not multi-gas cartridges or an oxygen source.
data.description: The 60921 combines a gas/vapor cartridge with a P100 particulate filter. Its documented scope covers certain organic vapors and oil or non-oil airborne particles when the complete respirator is properly selected and fitted. On a compatible 6800 full facepiece, use a matching pair in the approved configuration. The Canadian offer is recorded as a pair, but its actual model, seller and package quantity have not been independently verified.

data.name: 3M 60926 Multi-Gas/Vapor P100 Cartridge Filters
data.summary: Multi-gas/vapor cartridges with P100 particulate filters for approved 3M bayonet assemblies. Their specified contaminant range is broader than 60921, but it is not universal protection.
data.description: The 60926 combines P100 particulate filtration with a defined multi-gas/vapor cartridge. Manufacturer instructions list its eligible contaminants and use limits; the words multi-gas do not cover every chemical or concentration. A compatible 6800 uses two matching cartridges, selected for the assessed atmosphere and applicable approval. The recorded Canadian offer is described as a pair; the live model, supplier and quantity remain unverified.

importedAssets.reviewNote: Silver SOS-style packet and bars retained. Printed nutrition, ingredients and certification strings include synthetic inaccuracies and must not be used for dietary decisions. The manufacturer also has a 3600 versus 9x410 calorie conflict. Image depicts one packet, not proof of an ASIN two-pack.
